questions.question:
In a certain code language.

'X @ C' means 'X is the daughter of C',

'X $ C' means ' X is the husband of C',

'X = C' means ' X is the mother of C' and

'X * C' means 'X is the father of C'.

Based on the above, how is J related to N if 'N @ E $ J @ S'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 X is
 
 

 Symbol
 @
 $
 =
 *
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Husband
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 
 to C
 
 

Given: N @ E $ J @ S

N @ E → N is the daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43c01b67fae489eda197bfe6c2385370d1767cc843c2420c9020c48a9689945d.png] 

E $ J → E is the husband of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a71cb43ca7da260e6a4bb54c9e55ce5bbb03b00b6258ca2e3d424079ecd657be.png] 

J @ S → J is the daughter of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53e7fe4d60748b5f4fb500025d8f8aabf04356e1271168b6b35dffa3be64df4e.png] 

Thus, J is N's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gabions are walls.

All concretes are walls.

All bridges are walls.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bridges are gabions.

(II) Some concretes are bridges.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566c9be0077645860f21a53dedcc70c3761636afdc95d36bb7fac8efc2d304d9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some bridges are gabions → **Does not** follow (As all gabions are walls, all concretes are walls and all bridges are walls. So it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some concretes are bridges → Does not follow (As all concretes are walls and all bridges are walls. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1, D, E, O and S are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, F, A, R and M are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

Only D sits to the left of E. Only R sits to the left of A. Only one person sits between A and F. Only one person sits between D and O.

Which of the following represents both people facing each other?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

In row 1, D, E, O and S are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, F, A, R and M are seated and all of them are facing north.

1) Only D sits to the left of E.

2) Only R sits to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b13d6557bcc444b93b4954dcab8d83a1d3e60ff8173d2a2e9fe5f992935ae5e6.png] 

3) Only one person sits between A and F.

After positioning F only one position is left in row - 2 which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb57ae1c3acde30122c7a53e9043dc8ef42dfdb952fcea5c789e7502abcc03b.png] 

4) Only one person sits between D and O.

After positioning O only one position is left in row - 1 which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24a08889883afc2f1b9d5535d7396cedf2ce7c6532a2cb8b33bda196b230703c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement E and M face each other.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark '(?)' in the following equation, if '÷' and '×' are interchanged and '+' and '-' are interchanged?

50 - 9 ÷ 1 + 63 × 7 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 50 - 9 ÷ 1 + 63 × 7 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged:

50 - 9 ÷ 1 + 63 × 7 = ? ⇒ 50 + 9 × 1 - 63 ÷ 7 = ?

⇒ 50 + 9 × 1 - __**63 **____**÷**____** 7**__ = ?

⇒ 50 + __**9 **____**×**____** 1**__ - 9 = ?

⇒ __**50 + 9**__ - 9 = ?

⇒ __**59 - 9**__ = ?

⇒ 50 = ?

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
